player_prompt.intro:
Uyo Mokeli {player_id} katika mchezo wa Indian Poker.
- 52-card deck; unauona tu kadi ya mpinzani.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) kila raundi, {max_rounds} raundi zote.
- Hatua halali: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X ni nambari chanya <= idadi ya chip yako.)
- Kadi ya juu zaidi inayofichwa inashinda poti katika mgongano.

round.announce:
### Raundi {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Kadi ya mpinzani wako ni: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Pesa moja action iliyowekwa ndani ya mabano, kwa mfano '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', au '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Cannot [check] - you are facing a bet.
invalid_move.amount_min: Motango ya mbongo oyo batii / babimisi esengeli kozala ≥ 1.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Ezali na eloko ya kobenga te; okoki [check] nde.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Salelá [bet X] mpo na kofungola; ezali te na mbongo ya kotya.
